definitions.explanation: A thing or object, especially something for sale.
How good something for sale is. Refinement or class in a person is 品 read ひん.

examples.english: This store has a rich variety of goods.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{品|しな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{高|たか}くて→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧しまう。
examples.english: This shop's goods are good quality, so I buy here even if it's a little pricey.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧お⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{品|しな}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}くて→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{手頃|てごろ}→手頃：04068_tegoro⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{通|かよ}ってしまう→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: The goods at this shop are high quality and reasonably priced. I find myself coming back again and again.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦けれど→けれど：01990_keredo⟧{品|しな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: It's cheap, but the quality is poor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{品|しな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: This shop's goods have gone down in quality lately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{贈|おく}り{物|もの}→贈り物：01343_okurimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{品|しな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んでいる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I'm choosing an item to give as a present.

notes:
{品|しな} has two main meanings: physical goods or items, and the quality of goods. Refinement or class in a person is ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧, ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS (sense 1, goods):
- {品|しな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{揃|そろ}う→揃う：01953_sorou⟧ (goods are available)
- {品|しな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧ (to stock items)
- ⟦{品切|しなぎ}れ→品切れ：09557_shinagire⟧ (out of stock)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS (sense 2, quality of goods):
- {品|しな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (the goods are good quality)
- {品|しな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ / {品|しな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ (poor quality / the quality drops)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{品物|しなもの}→品物：00886_shinamono⟧ (goods, articles - emphasizes physical items)
- ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧ (product, merchandise)
- ⟦{上品|じょうひん}→上品：03081_jouhin⟧ (elegant, refined)
- ⟦{下品|げひん}→下品：00060_gehin⟧ (vulgar, coarse)

COUNTER: ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧/⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ for counting items
